items.title: Peter Ecklund interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 14, 1998
items.q: I did play with him maybe eight or ten times a year and I played on one of his recordings

ctx.x: Yeah. Sure. Were you playing when Woody Allen was there?
From time to time. I wasn’t doing it all the time but I did play with him maybe eight or ten times a year and I played on one of his recordings, but I haven’t played with him in a number of years.
